package.description: Classify Mistral greenhouse daytime and overnight humidity readings and provide the exact action code.
package.instructions: Choose the reference matching the recorded shift. The daytime reference is references/daytime.md. The overnight reference is references/overnight.md. Read the matching reference and apply its exact band, code, and response. Report the measured percentage, the classification, the code, and the recommended action. A reading without a named shift requires clarification.

assets.text:
# Mistral daytime humidity

| Humidity | Classification | Code | Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Below 45% | Dry | MIS-D-174 | Humidify during attended checks. |
| 45–62% inclusive | In range | MIS-D-732 | Keep daytime settings. |
| Above 62% | Vent | MIS-D-945 | Air the bench for 8 minutes. |

# Mistral overnight humidity

| Humidity | Classification | Code | Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Below 55% | Dry | MIS-N-164 | Check the reservoir at opening. |
| 55–76% inclusive | In range | MIS-N-330 | Keep overnight settings. |
| Above 76% | Vent | MIS-N-855 | Flag inspection at shift change. |
